QA-source: #32102 · studio-authoring.expression-editors · acceptance[4]

Stale-spec re-point card (checklist-test §5) for a checklist item in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json`.

## What the run measured

QA run #32102, subject `ff04ad81` (repro rule R-2 in the record):

- The formula-field USING predicate `record.f_total > 5` is saved to the draft once (PUT 200), and its server verdict (INVALID_FIELD) appears on the re-read.
- After that, edits beside the guard are held.
- Each new text of the guard PUTs once more.
- Publish refuses it with 422, so it never reaches the live set.

## Ruling

PR #31549, "Acceptance reading (seat ruling on the step-1 report)": "the first save of a refused guard goes out … An edit of the guard text itself goes out, to be judged again". No validate-only door exists, and #26858 forbids a client copy of the publish rule.

## Re-point

- acceptance[4].verify and negative[1]: for a formula-field predicate, "held" means held after the first save's verdict, and never published.
- knownGaps[3]: #27482 is closed, and the held line now reads "Fix the expression errors before saving.".
